messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

At the beginning the customer perceives that her subscribed service has degraded. A list with all the problem parameters is then sent to the Customer Service department of TELECO. At the customer service an employee enters (based on the received data) a problem report into system T.. Then the problem report is compared to the customer SLA to identify what the extent and the details of the service degradation are. Based on this, the necessary counter measures are determined including their respective priorities. An electronic service then determines the significance of the customer based on information that has been collected during the history of the contractual relationship. In case the customer is premium, the process will link to an extra problem fix process (this process will not be detailed here). In case the customer is of certain significance which would affect the counter measures previously decided upon, the process goes back to re-prioritize these measures otherwise the process continues. Taking together the information (i.e. contract commitment data + prioritized actions) a detailed problem report is created. The detailed problem report is then sent to Service Management. Service Management deals on a first level with violations of quality in services that are provided to customers. After receiving the detailed problem report, Service management investigates whether the problem is analyzable at the level of their department or whether the problem may be located at Resource Provisioning. In case Service Management assesses the problem to be not analyzable by themselves, the detailed problem report is sent out to Resource Provisioning. If Service Management is sure they can analyze it, they perform the analysis and based on the outcome they create a trouble report that indicates the type of problem. After Resource Provisioning receives the detailed problem report, it is checked whether there are any possible problems. If no problems are detected, a notification about the normal service execution is created. If a problem is detected this will be analyzed by Resource Provisioning and a trouble report is created. Either trouble report or the normal execution notification will be included in a status report and sent back to Service Management. Service Management then prepares the final status report based on the received information. Subsequently it has to be determined what counter measures should be taken depending on the information in the final status report. Three alternative process paths may be taken. For the case that no problem was detected at all, the actual service performance is sent back to the Customer Service. For the case that minor corrective actions are required, Service Management will undertake corrective actions by themselves. Subsequently, the problem resolution report is created and then sent out to Customer Service. After sending, this process path of Service Management ends. For the case that automatic resource restoration from Resource Provisioning is required, Service Management must create a request for automatic resource restoration. This message is then sent to Resource Provisioning. Resource Provisioning has been on-hold and waiting for a restoration request but this must happen within 2 days after the status report was sent out, otherwise Resource Provisioning terminates the process. After the restoration request is received, all possible errors are tracked. Based on the tracked errors, all necessary corrective actions are undertaken by Resource Provisioning. Then a trouble-shooting report is created. This report is sent out to Service Management; then the process ends. The trouble-shooting report is received by Service Management and this information goes then into the creation of the problem resolution report just as described for ii). Customer Service either receives the actual service performance (if there was no problem) or the problem resolution report. Then, two concurrent activities are triggered, i.e. i) a report is created for the customer which details the current service performance and the resolution of the problem, and ii) an SLA violation rebate is reported to Billing & Collections who will adjust the billing. The report for the customer is sent out to her. After all three activities are completed the process ends within Customer Service. After the customer then receives the report about service performance and problem resolution from Customer Service, the process flow at the customer also ends.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" id="Definitions_1" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn">
  <bpmn:process id="ServiceDegradationProcess" name="Service Degradation Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_CustomerPerceives" name="Customer perceives service degradation">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_CustomerPerceives" targetRef="Task_SendProblemParams" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendProblemParams" name="Send problem parameters to Customer Service">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_SendProblemParams" targetRef="Task_EnterProblemReport" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterProblemReport" name="Enter problem report into system T">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_EnterProblemReport" targetRef="Task_CompareSLA" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompareSLA" name="Compare problem report to customer SLA">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_CompareSLA" targetRef="Task_DetermineCounterMeasures" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineCounterMeasures" name="Determine necessary counter measures and priorities">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_DetermineCounterMeasures" targetRef="Task_DetermineSignificance" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineSignificance" name="Electronic service determines customer significance">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_DetermineSignificance" targetRef="Gateway_PremiumCheck" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PremiumCheck" name="Is Customer Premium?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PremiumYes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PremiumNo</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PremiumYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_PremiumCheck" targetRef="CallActivity_PremiumFix" />
    <bpmn:callActivity id="CallActivity_PremiumFix" name="Extra Problem Fix Process">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PremiumYes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PremiumReturn</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PremiumReturn" sourceRef="CallActivity_PremiumFix" targetRef="Gateway_SignificanceCheck" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PremiumNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_PremiumCheck" targetRef="Gateway_SignificanceCheck" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SignificanceCheck" name="Does significance affect counter measures?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PremiumReturn</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PremiumNo</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Reprioritize</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Continue</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reprioritize" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_SignificanceCheck" targetRef="Task_DetermineCounterMeasures" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Continue" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_SignificanceCheck" targetRef="Task_CreateDetailedReport" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateDetailedReport" name="Create detailed problem report (contract + prioritized actions)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Continue</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_CreateDetailedReport" targetRef="Task_SendToServiceMgmt" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendToServiceMgmt" name="Send detailed problem report to Service Management">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_SendToServiceMgmt" targetRef="Gateway_AnalyzableBySM" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AnalyzableBySM" name="Analyzable by Service Management?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SMAnalyze</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendToRP</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SMAnalyze" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AnalyzableBySM" targetRef="Task_SMAnalyze" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SMAnalyze" name="Service Management performs analysis">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SMAnalyze</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SMCreateTrouble</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SMCreateTrouble" sourceRef="Task_SMAnalyze" targetRef="Task_SMCreateTroubleReport" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SMCreateTroubleReport" name="Create trouble report (type of problem)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SMCreateTrouble</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToStatusMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendToRP" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AnalyzableBySM" targetRef="Task_RPReceiveReport" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RPReceiveReport" name="Resource Provisioning receives detailed problem report">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendToRP</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RPCheckProblems</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RPCheckProblems" sourceRef="Task_RPReceiveReport" targetRef="Gateway_RPProblemsDetected" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RPProblemsDetected" name="Problems detected?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RPCheckProblems</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoProblems</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ProblemsDetected</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoProblems" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RPProblemsDetected" targetRef="Task_CreateNormalNotification" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateNormalNotification" name="Create notification about normal service execution">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoProblems</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToStatusMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProblemsDetected" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RPProblemsDetected" targetRef="Task_RPAnalyze" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RPAnalyze" name="Resource Provisioning analyzes problem">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ProblemsDetected</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RPCreateTrouble</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RPCreateTrouble" sourceRef="Task_RPAnalyze" targetRef="Task_RPCreateTroubleReport" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RPCreateTroubleReport" name="Create trouble report">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RPCreateTrouble</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToStatusMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_StatusMerge" name="Merge Status Inputs">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToStatusMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CreateStatusReport</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CreateStatusReport" sourceRef="Gateway_StatusMerge" targetRef="Task_CreateStatusReport" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateStatusReport" name="Include in status report and send back to Service Management">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CreateStatusReport</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SMPrepareFinal</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SMPrepareFinal" sourceRef="Task_CreateStatusReport" targetRef="Task_SMPrepareFinalStatus" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SMPrepareFinalStatus" name="Service Management prepares final status report">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SMPrepareFinal</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DetermineCounterMeasuresFinal</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DetermineCounterMeasuresFinal" sourceRef="Task_SMPrepareFinalStatus" targetRef="Gateway_FinalDecision" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FinalDecision" name="Determine Counter Measures">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DetermineCounterMeasuresFinal</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoProblem</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MinorCorrective</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AutoRestoration</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    
    <!-- Path 1: No Problem -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoProblem" name="No problem detected" sourceRef="Gateway_FinalDecision" targetRef="Task_SendPerformanceToCS" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendPerformanceToCS" name="Send actual service performance to Customer Service">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoProblem</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToCSMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <!-- Path 2: Minor Corrective Actions -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MinorCorrective" name="Minor corrective actions required" sourceRef="Gateway_FinalDecision" targetRef="Task_SMUndertakeActions" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SMUndertakeActions" name="Service Management undertakes corrective actions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MinorCorrective</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CreateResolutionReport</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CreateResolutionReport" sourceRef="Task_SMUndertakeActions" targetRef="Task_CreateProblemResolutionReport" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateProblemResolutionReport" name="Create problem resolution report">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CreateResolutionReport</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendResolutionToCS</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendResolutionToCS" sourceRef="Task_CreateProblemResolutionReport" targetRef="Task_SendResolutionToCS" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendResolutionToCS" name="Send problem resolution report to Customer Service">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendResolutionToCS</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToCSMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <!-- Path 3: Automatic Resource Restoration -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AutoRestoration" name="Automatic resource restoration required" sourceRef="Gateway_FinalDecision" targetRef="Task_SMCreateRestorationRequest" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SMCreateRestorationRequest" name="Service Management creates request for automatic resource restoration">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AutoRestoration</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendRestorationReq</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendRestorationReq" sourceRef="Task_SMCreateRestorationRequest" targetRef="Task_SendRestorationToRP" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendRestorationToRP" name="Send restoration request to Resource Provisioning">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendRestorationReq</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RPWait</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_RPWait" name="Wait for restoration request (max 2 days)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RPWait</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RPReceived</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
        <bpmn:timeDuration>PT2D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RPReceived" sourceRef="Event_RPWait" targetRef="Task_RPTrackErrors" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RPTrackErrors" name="Resource Provisioning tracks all possible errors">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RPReceived</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RPCorrectiveActions</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RPCorrectiveActions" sourceRef="Task_RPTrackErrors" targetRef="Task_RPUndertakeActions" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RPUndertakeActions" name="Resource Provisioning undertakes necessary corrective actions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RPCorrectiveActions</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RPCreateTroubleshoot</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RPCreateTroubleshoot" sourceRef="Task_RPUndertakeActions" targetRef="Task_RPCreateTroubleshootReport" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RPCreateTroubleshootReport" name="Create trouble-shooting report">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RPCreateTroubleshoot</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RPSendToSM</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RPSendToSM" sourceRef="Task_RPCreateTroubleshootReport" targetRef="Task_RPSendTroubleshootToSM" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RPSendTroubleshootToSM" name="Send trouble-shooting report to Service Management">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RPSendToSM</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SMReceiveTroubleshoot</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SMReceiveTroubleshoot" sourceRef="Task_RPSendTroubleshootToSM" targetRef="Task_SMUseForResolution" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SMUseForResolution" name="Service Management uses info for problem resolution report">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SMReceiveTroubleshoot</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SMCreateFinalResolution</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SMCreateFinalResolution" sourceRef="Task_SMUseForResolution" targetRef="Task_SMCreateFinalResolutionReport" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SMCreateFinalResolutionReport" name="Create problem resolution report">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SMCreateFinalResolution</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SMSendFinalResolution</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SMSendFinalResolution" sourceRef="Task_SMCreateFinalResolutionReport" targetRef="Task_SMSendFinalResolutionToCS" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SMSendFinalResolutionToCS" name="Send problem resolution report to Customer Service">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SMSendFinalResolution</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToCSMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <!-- Merge to Customer Service -->
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CSMerge" name="Merge to Customer Service">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToCSMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CSParallelStart</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToCSMerge" sourceRef="Task_SendPerformanceToCS" targetRef="Gateway_CSMerge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToCSMerge2" sourceRef="Task_SendResolutionToCS" targetRef="Gateway_CSMerge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToCSMerge3" sourceRef="Task_SMSendFinalResolutionToCS" targetRef="Gateway_CSMerge" />
    
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CSParallelStart" sourceRef="Gateway_CSMerge" targetRef="Gateway_CSParallelSplit" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CSParallelSplit" name="Split Concurrent Activities">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CSParallelStart</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CreateCustomerReport</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReportRebate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CreateCustomerReport" sourceRef="Gateway_CSParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_CreateCustomerReport" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateCustomerReport" name="Create report for customer (service performance + resolution)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CreateCustomerReport</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendCustomerReport</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendCustomerReport" sourceRef="Task_CreateCustomerReport" targetRef="Task_SendReportToCustomer" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendReportToCustomer" name="Send report to customer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendCustomerReport</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToCSEndMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReportRebate" sourceRef="Gateway_CSParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_ReportRebate" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReportRebate" name="Report SLA violation rebate to Billing & Collections">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReportRebate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BillingAdjust</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BillingAdjust" sourceRef="Task_ReportRebate" targetRef="Task_BillingAdjust" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BillingAdjust" name="Billing & Collections adjusts billing">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BillingAdjust</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToCSEndMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CSEndMerge" name="End Merge">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToCSEndMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToCSEndMerge" sourceRef="Task_SendReportToCustomer" targetRef="Gateway_CSEndMerge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToCSEndMerge2" sourceRef="Task_BillingAdjust" targetRef="Gateway_CSEndMerge" />
    
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToEnd" sourceRef="Gateway_CSEndMerge" targetRef="EndEvent_ProcessEnd" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ProcessEnd" name="Process Ends">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
